nextControlledAction: Review and apply canonical safe repairs in small batches; never bulk-delete orphan or duplicate candidates.

classificationDefinitions.canonical-public: Governed route, sitemap route or principal entrypoint.
classificationDefinitions.source-register-or-bounded: Source/coverage page or bounded publication, often intentionally noindex.
classificationDefinitions.release-showcase: Release-numbered feature presentation; not automatically canonical devotional content.
classificationDefinitions.placeholder-or-generated: Generic, small or generated content requiring editorial review.
classificationDefinitions.duplicate-name-candidate: Filename anomaly only; preserve until references and canonical target are confirmed.
classificationDefinitions.orphan-quality-review: Substantive file missing semantic page structure.
classificationDefinitions.orphan-content-candidate: Substantive ungoverned HTML that may deserve route registration or consolidation.
classificationDefinitions.internal-evidence: Tooling, test, report or release evidence not intended for devotee navigation.
